function airport4BodyClear(bus,p){const me=trafficVehicleShape(bus,p.x,p.y,p.heading);for(const c of [...BUS_VEHICLES,...TRAFFIC_CARS,...allParkedCars(),PlayerCar]){if(c===bus||c.id===bus.id)continue;if(Math.abs(c.x-p.x)>170||Math.abs(c.y-p.y)>170)continue;if(vehicleBodiesOverlap(me,trafficVehicleShape(c),1.4))return false;}for(const n of NPC_PEDESTRIANS)if(!(n.ghost>0)&&Math.abs(n.x-p.x)<110&&Math.abs(n.y-p.y)<110&&pointHitsVehicleBody(n.x,n.y,7,me,1))return false;if(g77PlayerOnFoot()&&pointHitsVehicleBody(PlayerPed.x,PlayerPed.y,PLAYER_PERSON_RADIUS,me,1))return false;return !playerStaticBodyBlockedAtFor(bus,p);}

function airport4Tick(bus,dt,parked){
 if(bus.line!==4)return false;
 const m=bus.airport4;
 if(!m){if(bus.edgeId!=='F2-AIR-S'||bus.dirSign!==1||bus.turn||bus.t<AIRPORT4.entryT-.0008)return false;
  bus.speed=0;bus.wait=true;AIRPORT4.holdN=true;AIRPORT4.holdSeen=BUS_CLOCK.t;
  if(AIRPORT4.owner&&AIRPORT4.owner!==bus.id)return true;
  if(!airport4RoadClear(bus))return true;
  const p=termPose(AIRPORT4.entry,0);if(!airport4BodyClear(bus,p))return true;
  AIRPORT4.owner=bus.id;bus.airport4={phase:'in',s:0,v:0,dwell:0,reverse:false};bus.plan=null;bus.turn=null;bus.curbStop=null;return true;
 }
 if(m.phase==='dwell'){AIRPORT4.holdN=false;bus.speed=0;bus.wait=true;m.dwell-=dt;if(m.dwell<=0){m.phase='reverse';m.s=0;m.v=0;}return true;}
 const path=m.phase==='in'?AIRPORT4.entry:m.phase==='reverse'?AIRPORT4.reverse:AIRPORT4.exit;
 const left=Math.max(0,path.total-m.s);m.v=Math.min(m.v+28*dt,m.phase==='reverse'?12:22,Math.sqrt(2*35*left)+1);const ns=Math.min(path.total,m.s+m.v*dt),p=termPose(path,ns);if(m.phase==='reverse')p.heading+=Math.PI;
 if(m.phase==='out'&&m.s>path.total-130){AIRPORT4.holdN=true;AIRPORT4.holdSeen=BUS_CLOCK.t;if(!m.committed&&!airport4RoadClear(bus)){bus.speed=0;bus.wait=true;m.v=0;return true;}m.committed=true;}
 if(!airport4BodyClear(bus,p)){bus.speed=0;bus.wait=true;m.v=0;return true;}
 m.s=ns;bus.x=p.x;bus.y=p.y;bus.heading=p.heading;bus.speed=m.v;bus.wait=false;
 if(ns>=path.total-.01){
  if(m.phase==='in'){m.phase='dwell';m.s=0;m.v=0;bus.speed=0;const ex=exchangeBusPassengers(bus,AIRPORT4_PLAT_STOP,{final:true});spawnBusAlighters(bus,AIRPORT4_PLAT_STOP,ex.alight);m.dwell=9+ex.board*.3+ex.alight*.2;AIRPORT4.visits++;}
  else if(m.phase==='reverse'){m.phase='out';m.s=0;m.v=0;}
  else{bus.airport4=null;AIRPORT4.owner=null;AIRPORT4.holdN=false;AIRPORT4.dispatches++;bus.routeIndex=BUS_LINE_4_ROUTE.findIndex(s=>s.edgeId==='F2-AIR-S'&&s.dirSign===-1);bus.edgeId='F2-AIR-S';bus.dirSign=-1;bus.t=AIRPORT4.mergeT;bus.lane=0;bus.plan=null;bus.turn=null;bus.stopCursor=nextBusStopCursor(4,bus.routeIndex,bus.t);bus.speed=12;bus.stuck=0;}
 }return true;
}

 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:[...new Set(issues)],pad:[T.x,T.y,T.x+T.w,T.y+T.h],fenceY:EW2_FENCE_Y,towGate:[G.x0,G.x1],trainerSpan:+span.toFixed(1),hold:[H.x,H.y,H.x+H.w,H.y+H.h],pWestN:[EW2_PWN.x,EW2_PWN.y,EW2_PWN.x+EW2_PWN.w,EW2_PWN.y+EW2_PWN.h],jobs:EW2_JOB_IDS.length}}

  for(let guard=0;guard<12&&PlayerProfile.activeMission;guard++){m=PlayerProfile.activeMission;const s=ew2JobStep(m);if(!s)break;r.steps.push(s[0]);
   if(d.trainingKind==='marshal'){PlayerPed.x=s[1];PlayerPed.y=s[2];ew2MissionAction();for(let i=0;i<200&&Math.abs(m.aircraft.x-5198)>4;i++)step(m,d);ew2MissionAction();continue}

   if(s[0]==='pump'){put(s[1],s[2],0);ew2MissionAction();for(let i=0;i<200&&m.pump<86;i++)step(m,d);ew2MissionAction();continue}
   put(s[1],s[2]);step(m,d);const b=body();if(b)r.blocked.push(s[0]+':'+b);ew2MissionAction();if(s[0]==='load'&&d.trainingKind==='bags'){ew2MissionAction();ew2MissionAction()}}
  r.ok=!PlayerProfile.activeMission&&!r.blocked.length&&(d.trainingKind!=='tow'||(r.passOpen&&r.wingThroughGate&&!r.gateOpenAfter&&r.closedAfter==='APT-AIRFIELD'));}catch(e){r.error=String(e)}if(PlayerProfile.activeMission)missionFail('qa');out[d.trainingKind]=r}

function phoneNav(){

 const LINE_INFO=s267LineInfo();   /* S7F267 (R-86 ג6): the route of every line — from its route (busRouteText); the literal for the static check — s267LineInfo */

  const [title,routeText,note]=LINE_INFO[line],stops=[BUS_TERMINAL_STOPS[line],...busStopsForLine(line)],buses=BUS_VEHICLES.filter(b=>b.line===line),totalWaiting=stops.reduce((sum,st)=>sum+busPassengerStop(st.id).waiting,0);
  const rows=stops.map(st=>`<div class="plic"><div class="plid">${line}</div><div class="plt"><b>${st.label.replace(`קו ${line} · `,'')}</b><small>${st.chunk||''} · ממתינים ${busPassengerStop(st.id).waiting}</small></div><button data-nav-target="${st.id}">נווט</button></div>`).join('');
  return pcard(title,pkv([['אוטובוסים פעילים',buses.length],['תחנות',stops.length],['נוסעים ממתינים',totalWaiting],['מסלול',busRouteText(line)]])+rows+pnote(note+' יוצא וחוזר למסוף האוטובוסים ב-E3.'),'nav')

  +lineCard(1)+lineCard(2)+lineCard(3)+airport4PhoneCard()

}

function g88GarageAudit(){const o={ok:false,colours:[],rims:[],pixel:[],preview:null,models:{}};try{

  const d=g.getImageData(0,0,cv.width,cv.height).data,vote=new Array(P.length).fill(0);for(let i=0;i<d.length;i+=4){if(d[i+3]<250)continue;let b=-1,bd=40;for(let k=0;k<rgb.length;k++){const e=Math.hypot(d[i]-rgb[k][0],d[i+1]-rgb[k][1],d[i+2]-rgb[k][2]);if(e<bd){bd=e;b=k}}if(b>=0)vote[b]++}
  let win=0;for(let k=1;k<vote.length;k++)if(vote[k]>vote[win])win=k;o.pixel.push({idx,name,drawn:G88_PAL_HE[P[win]?.[0]],votes:vote[idx],ok:win===idx})}

  const da=ca.getImageData(0,0,A.width,A.height).data,db=cb.getImageData(0,0,B.width,B.height).data;let n=0;for(let i=0;i<da.length;i++)if(Math.abs(da[i]-db[i])>2)n++;
  o.preview={asset:PlayerCar.asset,thumb:tid,c:[ps.c??0,tc],r:[ps.r??0,tr],v:[ps.v??0,tv],diffPx:n,ok:tid===PlayerCar.asset&&tc===(ps.c??0)&&tr===(ps.r??0)&&tv===(ps.v??0)&&n===0}}

function fishingBaitKey(habitat='lake'){const inv=PlayerProfile.inventory||{},ids=habitat==='coastal'?COAST_BAIT_IDS:LAKE_BAIT_IDS;return ids.find(id=>(inv[id]||0)>0)||null}
function fishingSizeChances(rod,bait,habitat='lake'){const table=habitat==='coastal'?COAST_ROD_SIZE_ODDS:ROD_SIZE_ODDS;let p=[...(table[clamp(rod|0,1,5)]||table[1])],shift=fishingBaitsFor(habitat)[bait]?.sizeShift||[0,0,0,0];p=p.map((v,i)=>Math.max(.1,v+(shift[i]||0)));const sum=p.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)||100;return p.map(v=>v*100/sum)}
function fishingSpeciesWeights(rod,bait,habitat='lake',zone='pier'){const key=LAKE_BAITS[bait]?.key||'bread',idx=COAST_BAITS[bait]?.index||0,rows=fishingSpeciesFor(habitat).filter(q=>rod>=q.minRod);return rows.map(q=>{let w=habitat==='coastal'?q.weights[idx]:q[key]??1;if(habitat==='coastal'){if(['FS-SE-05','FS-SE-07','FS-SE-12'].includes(q.id))w*=.07;if(zone==='rock'&&['FS-SE-05','FS-SE-12'].includes(q.id))w*=1.8;if(zone==='sand'&&q.id==='FS-SE-13')w*=1.7}const rf=(RODS[clamp(rod|0,1,5)-1]||{}).fish||[];return{q,w:Math.max(.005,w)*(1+(Math.max(1,rod)-1)*(q.quality||0)*.10)*(rf.includes(q.id)?1.6:1)}})}
function fishingSpeciesChances(rod,bait,habitat='lake',zone='pier'){const rows=fishingSpeciesWeights(rod,bait,habitat,zone),sum=rows.reduce((n,x)=>n+x.w,0)||1;return rows.map(x=>({id:x.q.id,name:x.q.name,pct:x.w/sum*100,quality:x.q.quality}))}
function fishingQualityProfile(rod,bait,habitat='lake',zone='pier'){const sz=fishingSizeChances(rod,bait,habitat),sp=fishingSpeciesChances(rod,bait,habitat,zone),premium=sp.filter(x=>x.quality>=2).reduce((n,x)=>n+x.pct,0);return{sizes:sz,premium,largePlus:sz[2]+sz[3],trophy:sz[3]}}
function chooseLakeFish(bait,rod,habitat='lake',zone='pier',rnd=Math.random){const rows=fishingSpeciesWeights(rod,bait,habitat,zone),sum=rows.reduce((n,x)=>n+x.w,0);let r=rnd()*sum;for(const x of rows){r-=x.w;if(r<=0)return x.q}return rows[0]?.q||fishingSpeciesFor(habitat)[0]}
function lakeFishSizeIndex(rod,bait,habitat='lake',rnd=Math.random){const p=fishingSizeChances(rod,bait,habitat),r=rnd()*100;if(r<p[0])return 0;if(r<p[0]+p[1])return 1;if(r<p[0]+p[1]+p[2])return 2;return 3}
function fishSellValue(row){const sp=[...LAKE_FISH,...COAST_FISH].find(q=>q.id===row?.id);if(sp){const si=Math.max(0,FISH_SIZE_NAMES.indexOf(row?.size));return Math.max(8,Math.round(sp.value*FISH_VALUE_MULT[si]*(row?.lengthCm||sp.base)/(sp.base||40)))}if(Number.isFinite(row?.value))return row.value;return 18}

function fishingWaitMs(){const waits=[2000,4000,6000,8000,10000,12000];return waits[Math.floor(Math.random()*waits.length)]}
function prepareLakeCatch(spot,bait,rod){const habitat=spot.habitat==='coastal'?'coastal':'lake',sizeIndex=lakeFishSizeIndex(rod,bait,habitat),species=chooseLakeFish(bait,rod,habitat,spot.zone),length=Math.max(habitat==='coastal'?7:12,Math.round(species.base*FISH_SIZE_SCALE[sizeIndex]*(.88+Math.random()*.22))),value=Math.max(8,Math.round(species.value*FISH_VALUE_MULT[sizeIndex]*length/species.base)),caughtAt=iso(),catchId='FISH-'+Date.now().toString(36)+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7);return{catchId,id:species.id,name:species.name,size:FISH_SIZE_NAMES[sizeIndex],sizeIndex,lengthCm:length,value,spot:spot.id,habitat,bait,rod,caughtAt}}

/* p648: the longest fish possible — the longest species of the lake and of the sea at the record size (the length of a catch reaches 1.1 × its scale) */
function fishx8Max(){if(fishx8Max.v)return fishx8Max.v;let b=60;try{for(const q of LAKE_FISH)b=Math.max(b,q.base||0);for(const q of COAST_FISH)b=Math.max(b,+q[2]||0)}catch(e){}return fishx8Max.v=b*Math.max(...FISH_SIZE_SCALE)*1.1}

function openFishingSetup(spot){const f=ensureFishingSchema();if(!spot)return toast('התקרב לעמדת דיג באגם או בחוף');if(spot.habitat==='coastal'&&(PlayerProfile.mode!=='walk'||Math.hypot(PlayerPed.x-spot.x,PlayerPed.y-spot.y)>42))return toast('עמוד ליד נקודת הדיג שעל המזח או בחוף');if(!licenseOwned('LIC-11'))return toast('צריך רישיון FISH-A · חנות הדיג ב-C2 או B6');if(State.fishingSession?.busy)return toast(State.fishingSession.phase==='bite'?'יש נשיכה — לחץ F למשיכה':'החכה כבר במים');const habitat=fishingContext(spot),bait=fishingBaitKey(habitat);State.fishingSpot=spot.id;State.fishingSetup={spot:spot.id,rod:Math.max(1,f.rodLevel||1),bait:FISHX.fitsLv(Math.max(1,f.rodLevel||1),bait)?bait:(Object.keys(fishingBaitsFor(habitat)).find(id=>FISHX.fitsLv(Math.max(1,f.rodLevel||1),id)&&(PlayerProfile.inventory[id]||0)>0)||bait)};$('fishingSetupPanel').querySelector('.sub').textContent=(habitat==='coastal'?'דיג חוף · ':'דיג אגם · ')+spot.label+' · בחר חכה ופיתיון.';$('fishingSetupOverlay').classList.add('show');$('fishingSetupPanel').scrollTop=0;Input.held.clear();renderFishingSetup();return true}
function startFishingFromSetup(){const st=State.fishingSetup;if(!st)return false;const spot=fishingSpotById(st.spot),rod=st.rod,bait=st.bait;if(!spot)return toast('עמדת הדיג לא נמצאה');if(!bait||(PlayerProfile.inventory[bait]||0)<=0){renderFishingSetup();return toast('בחר פיתיון שקיים בתיק')}closeFishingSetup();return startLakeFishing(spot,rod,bait)}
function startLakeFishing(spotArg=null,rodArg=null,baitArg=null){const spot=spotArg||nearbyB2FishingSpot(78)||fishingSpotById(State.fishingSpot),f=ensureFishingSchema();if(!spot)return toast('התקרב לעמדת דיג באגם או בחוף');const habitat=fishingContext(spot),baits=fishingBaitsFor(habitat);if(habitat==='coastal'&&(PlayerProfile.mode!=='walk'||Math.hypot(PlayerPed.x-spot.x,PlayerPed.y-spot.y)>28))return toast('התקרב לעמדת הדיג');if(!licenseOwned('LIC-11'))return toast('צריך רישיון FISH-A מחנות הדיג ב-C2 או B6');if(State.fishingSession?.busy)return toast((State.fishingSession.phase==='bite'||State.fishingSession.phase==='reel')?'יש דג על החכה — לחץ F למשיכה':'החכה כבר במים');const rod=clamp(Number(rodArg)||f.rodLevel||1,1,f.rodLevel||1),bait=baitArg;if(!Object.hasOwn(baits,bait)||(PlayerProfile.inventory[bait]||0)<=0)return toast('בחר פיתיון שקיים בתיק');if(!FISHX.fitsLv(rod,bait))return toast('הפיתיון לא מתאים לחכה הזו');if(!baits[bait]?.reusable){PlayerProfile.inventory[bait]--;if(PlayerProfile.inventory[bait]<=0)delete PlayerProfile.inventory[bait]}PlayerPed.dir=spot.dir??(spot.id.endsWith('4')?6:2);const now=performance.now(),waitMs=fishingWaitMs(),session={busy:true,phase:'cast',spot:spot.id,habitat,bait,rod,startedAt:now,castEndsAt:now+450,biteDueAt:now+waitMs,waitMs,hooked:null,reelStartedAt:null,reelDuration:1200,pullCount:0,pullsNeeded:0,escapeAt:null,landing:false};State.fishingSession=session;State.fishingSpot=spot.id;SaveManager.log('fishing','cast',{spot:spot.id,bait,rod,waitMs});SaveManager.save('fishing-cast',{backup:false,silent:true});/* p640 (K-175): no toast — the hint line says it */return true}
function finishLakeCatch(session){if(!session?.hooked)return false;const f=ensureFishingSchema(),row=session.hooked,prev=f.records[row.id],newRecord=!prev||row.lengthCm>Number(prev.lengthCm||0);f.inventory.push(row);if(f.inventory.length>50)f.inventory.shift();f.totalCaught++;if(newRecord)f.records[row.id]={...row,recordAt:iso()};if(!f.bestValueCatch||Number(row.value||0)>Number(f.bestValueCatch.value||0))f.bestValueCatch={...row,bestValueAt:iso()};State.fishingSession={busy:false,last:row,lastAt:performance.now(),hooked:null};recordTransaction('fish-caught',0,{fish:row.id,size:row.size,lengthCm:row.lengthCm,value:row.value,newRecord});SaveManager.log('fishing','caught',{id:row.id,size:row.size,lengthCm:row.lengthCm,value:row.value,spot:row.spot,rod:row.rod,bait:row.bait,newRecord});syncAchievements(true);SaveManager.save('fishing-catch',{backup:false,silent:true});fishx7Card(row,newRecord);   /* p642: the catch card instead of the toast (K-175) */return true}
function fishPullsNeeded(row){const i=Number.isInteger(row?.sizeIndex)?row.sizeIndex:Math.max(0,FISH_SIZE_NAMES.indexOf(row?.size));return [2,3,4,6][clamp(i,0,3)]}
function fishPullEscapeChance(session){const i=clamp(Number.isInteger(session?.hooked?.sizeIndex)?session.hooked.sizeIndex:0,0,3),base=[.012,.022,.045,.075][i],rod=clamp(session?.rod||1,1,5);return clamp(base-(rod-1)*.009,.004,.10)}
function fishFightRemainingMs(session,now=performance.now()){return Math.max(0,(session?.escapeAt||now)-now)}
function escapeLakeFish(reason='escaped'){const s=State.fishingSession;if(!s?.busy||!s.hooked)return false;const f=ensureFishingSchema(),row=s.hooked;f.totalEscaped++;SaveManager.log('fishing','escaped',{id:row.id,size:row.size,reason,pulls:s.pullCount||0,needed:s.pullsNeeded||0,rod:s.rod,bait:s.bait});State.fishingSession={busy:false,lastEscape:{...row,reason,at:iso()},hooked:null};SaveManager.save('fishing-escape',{backup:false,silent:true});toast(reason==='timeout'?row.name+' ברח — לא משכת בזמן':row.name+' השתחרר מהקרס!');return true}
function reelLakeFishing(){const s=State.fishingSession;if(!s?.busy)return toast('אין חכה פעילה');if(!['bite','reel'].includes(s.phase)||s.landing)return toast(s.landing?'מעלה את הדג…':'עדיין אין נשיכה');const now=performance.now();if(now>=(s.escapeAt||Infinity))return escapeLakeFish('timeout');s.phase='reel';s.pullCount=(s.pullCount||0)+1;SaveManager.log('fishing','pull',{spot:s.spot,id:s.hooked?.id,pull:s.pullCount,needed:s.pullsNeeded});if(s.pullCount<s.pullsNeeded&&Math.random()<fishPullEscapeChance(s))return escapeLakeFish('struggle');if(s.pullCount>=s.pullsNeeded){s.landing=true;s.reelStartedAt=now;s.reelDuration=1200;toast('משיכה אחרונה — הדג עולה!');return true}toast('משוך שוב! '+s.pullCount+'/'+s.pullsNeeded);return true}
function updateFishingActionButton(){const b=$('fishingActionBtn'),s=State.fishingSession;if(!b)return;const active=!!s?.busy&&['bite','reel'].includes(s.phase)&&!s.landing&&!State.phoneOpen&&!State.mapOpen&&!State.fishingSetup;b.classList.toggle('show',active);b.disabled=!active;if(active){const left=(fishFightRemainingMs(s)/1000).toFixed(1),done=s.pullCount||0,need=s.pullsNeeded||1;b.textContent=`🎣 F · משוך! ${done}/${need} · ${left} שנ׳`}else b.textContent='🎣 משוך! (F)'}
function updateFishing(now){const s=State.fishingSession;if(!s?.busy)return;if(s.phase==='cast'&&now>=s.castEndsAt)s.phase='waiting';if(s.phase==='waiting'&&now>=s.biteDueAt){const spot=fishingSpotById(s.spot);if(!spot){State.fishingSession=null;return}s.hooked=prepareLakeCatch(spot,s.bait,s.rod||1);s.phase='bite';s.biteAt=now;s.pullCount=0;s.pullsNeeded=fishPullsNeeded(s.hooked);s.escapeAt=now+7000;s.landing=false;SaveManager.log('fishing','bite',{spot:s.spot,id:s.hooked.id,size:s.hooked.size,waitMs:s.waitMs,rod:s.rod,bait:s.bait,pullsNeeded:s.pullsNeeded});toast('יש נשיכה! '+s.pullsNeeded+' משיכות F · יש לך 7 שניות')}if(['bite','reel'].includes(s.phase)&&!s.landing&&now>=(s.escapeAt||Infinity)){escapeLakeFish('timeout');return}if(s.phase==='reel'&&s.landing&&now-(s.reelStartedAt||now)>=(s.reelDuration||1200))finishLakeCatch(s)}
function fishingActionAtSpot(spot){const s=State.fishingSession;if(s?.busy){if(s.spot!==spot.id)return toast('יש חכה פעילה בעמדה אחרת');if(['bite','reel'].includes(s.phase)&&!s.landing)return reelLakeFishing();if(s.landing)return toast('מעלה את הדג…');return toast('ממתינים לנשיכה…')}if(State.fishingSetup)return true;return openFishingSetup(spot)}

function a4Action(action,arg){
 const p=a4Held();if(!p){toast('התקרב ברגל לכניסה או לעמדת האימון ופתח עם F');return false}
 if(action==='save'){SaveManager.save('a4-manual',{backup:false,silent:true});toast('המשחק נשמר');return true}
 if(action==='cancel'){State.a4Game=null;renderPhone();return true}
 if(action==='practice'){
  const q=A4_PRACTICES[arg];if(!q||q.poi!==p.id)return false;if(PlayerProfile.activeMission||State.licenseExam){toast('סיים את המשימה הפעילה לפני האימון');return false}if(State.a4Game&&State.a4Game.phase!=='done')return false;
  State.a4Game={kind:arg,poi:p.id,elapsed:0,roundAt:0,shots:0,score:0,aim:.5,phase:'ready',shotAt:0,shotPower:0,shotAim:.5,result:'',awarded:false,lastDraw:0};renderPhone();return true
 }
 if(action==='shoot'){
  const g=State.a4Game;if(!g||g.poi!==p.id||g.phase!=='ready'||State.paused)return false;
  const power=a4PracticePower(g),aim=g.aim,keeper=a4PracticeKeeper(g,720),hit=g.kind==='basket'?Math.abs(power-.72)<=.105&&Math.abs(aim-.5)<=.12:g.kind==='penalty'?power>=.57&&power<=.84&&aim>=.06&&aim<=.94&&Math.abs(aim-keeper)>.17:power>=.73&&power<=.87;
  Object.assign(g,{phase:'shot',shotAt:g.elapsed,shotPower:power,shotAim:aim,keeperAtShot:keeper,hit,result:hit?'הצלחה ✓':g.kind==='penalty'&&Math.abs(aim-keeper)<=.17?'השוער עצר':'נסה שוב'});g.shots++;if(hit)g.score++;renderPhone();return true
 }
 return false
}

function g7Ui(s){if(typeof s!=='string'||!/[A-Za-z]/.test(s))return s;
 s=s.replace(/\((F)(\d{1,2})\)/g,'(\u0003$2)').replace(/(^|[\s·])F(\d{1,2})(?= — (?:חזרה|יציאה|סגירה|פתיחה))/g,'$1\u0003$2');   /* p470 (R-51): a key is a key, not a zone */
 for(const [a,b] of G7_UI_PH)if(s.includes(a))s=s.split(a).join(b);
 s=s.replace(/\b(VH|VS|LV)-[A-Z]{2}-\d{2}\b/g,id=>(typeof VEHICLE_CATALOG!=='undefined'&&VEHICLE_CATALOG[id]?.name)||G7_VEH_HE[id]||'הרכב');
 s=s.replace(/\bLIC-\d{2}\b/g,g7LicName);
 s=s.replace(/(^|[\s(·:])(B|TAXI|C1|C|BUS|TOW|EMERGENCY|AGRI|BOAT-A|BOAT-B|FISH-A|FISH-OFF|RAIL|PPL|CPL|HELI|AIRSIDE|PORT-EQ) — /g,'$1');
 s=s.replace(/(רישיון|נדרש|במונית|במשאית|באוטובוס) (B|TAXI|C1|C|BUS|TOW|EMERGENCY|AGRI|BOAT-A|BOAT-B|FISH-A|FISH-OFF|RAIL|PPL|CPL|HELI|AIRSIDE|PORT-EQ)(?![A-Za-z0-9-])/g,(m,w,c)=>w+' '+(w==='נדרש'?'רישיון ':'')+G7_LICCLS[c]);
 s=s.replace(/(^|[\s(·:;,]|^)(B|TAXI|C1|BUS|FISH-A|FISH-OFF|BOAT-A|BOAT-B|PPL|CPL|HELI|AIRSIDE|PORT-EQ) (נבחן|פותח)/g,(m,p,c,w)=>p+'רישיון '+G7_LICCLS[c]+' '+w);
 s=s.replace(/\bL([1-5])\b/g,'דרגה $1');
 s=s.replace(/ו-([A-H][0-9])(?![A-Za-z0-9\-‑])/g,(m,z)=>{const p=G7_ZONE[z];return p?'ו'+p:m});s=s.replace(/([בלמ])-([A-H][0-9])(?![A-Za-z0-9\-‑])/g,(m,b,z)=>{const p=G7_ZONE[z];return p?b+p.replace(/^ה/,''):m});
 s=s.replace(/(^|[^A-Za-z0-9\-‑])([A-H][0-9])(?![A-Za-z0-9\-‑])/g,(m,pre,z,off,str)=>{const p=G7_ZONE[z];if(!p)return m;
  const before=str.slice(0,off+pre.length).trimEnd(),words=before.split(/\s+/).filter(w=>/[\u0590-\u05FF]/.test(w)).slice(-2),last=/[\u0590-\u05FF]$/.test(before)?words[words.length-1]:null;
  if(!last)return pre+p;const first=p.split(' ')[0].replace(/^ה/,'');if(last.replace(/^ה/,'')===first)return pre+'\u0001'+p.split(' ').slice(1).join(' ');if(p.split(' ').some(q=>q.length>2&&words.some(w=>w.includes(g7Root(q)))))return pre.replace(/\s+$/,'')+'\u0002';return pre+p});
 s=s.replace(/\s*\u0002/g,'').replace(/\u0001/g,'').replace(/\s{2,}/g,' ');
 for(const w in G7_UI_WORD)s=s.replace(new RegExp('\\b'+w+'\\b','g'),G7_UI_WORD[w]);
 return s.replace(/\u0003(\d)/g,'F$1')}

const TC_GRID={cols:[0,1200,2400,3600,4800,6000,7200,8400,9600],rows:[-850,0,850,1700,2550,3400,4250,5200,6050,6900,7750]};
function tcZoneAt(x,y){const C=TC_GRID.cols,R=TC_GRID.rows;let i=-1,j=-1;for(let k=0;k<C.length-1;k++)if(x>=C[k]&&x<C[k+1])i=k;for(let k=0;k<R.length-1;k++)if(y>=R[k]&&y<R[k+1])j=k;
 if(i<0||j<0)return null;const code='ABCDEFGH'[i]+j;return{code,name:TC_NAMES.zones[code]||''}}
function tcStreetAt(x,y){let best=null,bd=1e9;for(const s of TC_NAMES.streets){if(!s.name)continue;const p=s.pts;for(let k=0;k<p.length-1;k++){const ax=p[k][0],ay=p[k][1],bx=p[k+1][0],by=p[k+1][1],dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay,L=dx*dx+dy*dy||1,t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((x-ax)*dx+(y-ay)*dy)/L)),d=Math.hypot(x-ax-t*dx,y-ay-t*dy)-s.hw;if(d<bd){bd=d;best=s}}}
 return best&&bd<=160?best.name:''}
function tcWhereText(x,y){const z=tcZoneAt(x,y);if(!z)return'מחוץ לעיר';const st=tcStreetAt(x,y);return z.code+' · '+z.name+(st?' · '+st:'')}

function saObstacles(){const O={edges:[],pave:[],circ:[],rect:[],obb:[]};const add=(a,x0,y0,x1,y1,id)=>a.push([Math.min(x0,x1),Math.min(y0,y1),Math.max(x0,x1),Math.max(y0,y1),id]);

 for(const [id,d] of Object.entries(deg)){const n=byNode[id];if(d.k>=2&&n)add(O.pave,n.x-d.hw,n.y-d.hw,n.x+d.hw,n.y+d.hw,'node:'+id)}

 for(const r of [...C4_ACCESS,...C4_YARDS])if(r&&isFinite(r.w))add(O.pave,r.x,r.y,r.x+r.w,r.y+r.h,r.id);
 // the posts: the city's lamps and signal poles at their drawn base, the zones' lamps; the trees (a trunk of 4 px)

 // the buildings, the solids of C4 / D4 (fences, containers, pallets, the fuel island, the canopy posts, the standing equipment), the moving forklifts' lanes

function saNear(O,x0,y0,x1,y1){const m=200,f=r=>r[0]<x1+m&&r[2]>x0-m&&r[1]<y1+m&&r[3]>y0-m;
 return{edges:O.edges.filter(e=>Math.min(e[0],e[2])-e[4]<x1+m&&Math.max(e[0],e[2])+e[4]>x0-m&&Math.min(e[1],e[3])-e[4]<y1+m&&Math.max(e[1],e[3])+e[4]>y0-m),pave:O.pave.filter(f),rect:O.rect.filter(f),
  circ:O.circ.filter(c=>c[0]>x0-m&&c[0]<x1+m&&c[1]>y0-m&&c[1]<y1+m),obb:O.obb.filter(c=>c[0]>x0-m&&c[0]<x1+m&&c[1]>y0-m&&c[1]<y1+m)}}
function saAsph(O,x,y){for(const e of O.edges){const dx=e[2]-e[0],dy=e[3]-e[1],l2=dx*dx+dy*dy;if(l2<1)continue;const u=((x-e[0])*dx+(y-e[1])*dy)/l2;if(u<0||u>1)continue;const px=e[0]+dx*u-x,py=e[1]+dy*u-y;if(px*px+py*py<=e[4]*e[4])return true}
 for(const b of O.pave)if(x>=b[0]&&x<=b[2]&&y>=b[1]&&y<=b[3])return true;return false}
// one rectangle [cx,cy,h,L,W] grown by pad: the first thing it touches (or null)
function saHit(O,r,pad){const cx=r[0],cy=r[1],c=Math.cos(r[2]),n=Math.sin(r[2]),hl=r[3]/2+pad,hw=r[4]/2+pad,ac=Math.abs(c),an=Math.abs(n);
 for(const q of O.circ){const dx=q[0]-cx,dy=q[1]-cy,u=Math.abs(dx*c+dy*n)-hl,w=Math.abs(-dx*n+dy*c)-hw;if(u<q[2]&&w<q[2]){const ou=Math.max(0,u),ow=Math.max(0,w);if(ou*ou+ow*ow<q[2]*q[2])return q[3]}}
 const ex=ac*hl+an*hw,ey=an*hl+ac*hw;
 for(const b of O.rect){if(cx+ex<=b[0]||cx-ex>=b[2]||cy+ey<=b[1]||cy-ey>=b[3])continue;const bw=(b[2]-b[0])/2,bh=(b[3]-b[1])/2,dx=(b[0]+b[2])/2-cx,dy=(b[1]+b[3])/2-cy;
  if(Math.abs(dx*c+dy*n)>=hl+bw*ac+bh*an)continue;if(Math.abs(-dx*n+dy*c)>=hw+bw*an+bh*ac)continue;return b[4]}
 for(const q of O.obb){const dx=q[0]-cx,dy=q[1]-cy;if(Math.abs(dx)>ex+q[3]+q[4]||Math.abs(dy)>ey+q[3]+q[4])continue;const k=Math.cos(q[2]),m=Math.sin(q[2]);let sep=false;
  for(const [ux,uy] of [[c,n],[-n,c],[k,m],[-m,k]]){const p=Math.abs(dx*ux+dy*uy),ra=hl*Math.abs(c*ux+n*uy)+hw*Math.abs(-n*ux+c*uy),rb=q[3]*Math.abs(k*ux+m*uy)+q[4]*Math.abs(-m*ux+k*uy);if(p>=ra+rb){sep=true;break}}if(!sep)return 'parked:'+q[5]}
 // off the asphalt: the outline (every 3 px or less) and the middle line
 const nu=Math.ceil(2*hl/3),nw=Math.ceil(2*hw/3);for(let i=0;i<=nu;i++){const u=-hl+2*hl*i/nu;for(const w of [-hw,0,hw]){const x=cx+c*u-n*w,y=cy+n*u+c*w;if(!saAsph(O,x,y))return 'sidewalk@'+Math.round(x)+','+Math.round(y)}}
 for(let j=1;j<nw;j++){const w=-hw+2*hw*j/nw;for(const u of [-hl,hl]){const x=cx+c*u-n*w,y=cy+n*u+c*w;if(!saAsph(O,x,y))return 'sidewalk@'+Math.round(x)+','+Math.round(y)}}
 return null}
// one path of the front: s from s0 to s1 in steps ≤ 2 px; the result — poses checked, the hits (the first of each kind)
function saSweep(O0,P,s0,s1,tag,out){const G=SEMI_ART,lo=Math.min(s0,s1),hi=Math.max(s0,s1);let x0=1e9,y0=1e9,x1=-1e9,y1=-1e9;for(const q of P){if(q.d<lo-200||q.d>hi+20)continue;x0=Math.min(x0,q.x);y0=Math.min(y0,q.y);x1=Math.max(x1,q.x);y1=Math.max(y1,q.y)}
 const O=saNear(O0,x0,y0,x1,y1),n=Math.max(1,Math.ceil((hi-lo)/G.step));let bad=0;const seen=new Set();
 for(let i=0;i<=n;i++){const s=lo+(hi-lo)*i/n,o=saPoseOn(P,s,{}),R=saRects(o);for(let k=0;k<2;k++){const h=saHit(O,R[k],G.pad);if(h){bad++;const key=(k?'trailer ':'tractor ')+h.replace(/@.*/,'');if(!seen.has(key)){seen.add(key);out.hits.push(tag+' · '+(k?'trailer':'tractor')+' × '+h+' @'+Math.round(o.fx)+','+Math.round(o.fy))}}}}
 out.poses+=n+1;out.paths++;if(bad)out.badPaths.push(tag);return bad}

/* p636: the blocking scan — no layer draws a person (P34) or a kit (KIT34) at a fixed low density, nor caps it at 2 */
function p636Args(src,i){let d=0,cur='',out=[],q=null;for(let j=i;j<src.length&&j<i+4000;j++){const c=src[j];
  if(q){cur+=c;if(c===q&&src[j-1]!=='\\')q=null;continue}if(c==="'"||c==='"'||c==='`'){q=c;cur+=c;continue}
  if(c==='('||c==='['||c==='{')d++;else if(c===')'||c===']'||c==='}'){if(d===0){out.push(cur);return out}d--}
  if(c===','&&d===0){out.push(cur);cur=''}else cur+=c}return out}

// one head: the first head of a junction in view draws the whole junction from its bitmap; returns the fit (as drawPole) or null — then by itself
function g371Head(o,p){const C=G371;if(!C.act)return null;const n=o.node;if(C.vec.has(n))return null;

  let sig='';const V=[];for(const h of G.list){const v=h.ped?(r76WalkOk(p,h.axis)?5:4):signalVehicleVariantForAxis(p,h.axis);V.push(v);sig+=v}
  const m=C.m,S=m.a,ex=S*G.x0+m.e,ey=S*G.y0+m.f;let ix=Math.floor(ex),iy=Math.floor(ey),qx=Math.round((ex-ix)*C.q),qy=Math.round((ey-iy)*C.q);if(qx===C.q){qx=0;ix++}if(qy===C.q){qy=0;iy++}
  const key=n+'|'+sig+'|'+S.toFixed(5)+'|'+qx+qy;let E=C.map.get(key);
  if(!E){if(C.stN<C.stable||C.nw>=C.maxNew){C.vec.add(n);C.stats.vec++;return null}E=g371Make(G,V,S,qx/C.q,qy/C.q);if(!E){C.vec.add(n);C.stats.vec++;return null}C.map.set(key,E);C.bytes+=E.bytes;C.nw++;C.stats.made++}
  E.last=C.fr;E.n=C.n;C.done.add(n);C.stats.hit++;g371Blit(E.cv,ix-E.P,iy-E.P)}

/* ZONELOOK (zonelook3, 1.11: + the basketball court and the ramps of the underground car parks) · the zones' ground, the city's items and what moves (1.11, the owner 09:49 / 09:58: "up a level") — B4 first, then B3.
   One file for the sheets and the game: ZONELOOK.create() gives one zone its own instance (B4LOOK, B3LOOK); every part is optional.

(function () {

  function inV(v, x0, y0, x1, y1) { return !v || (x1 > v[0] && x0 < v[2] && y1 > v[1] && y0 < v[3]); }

  function paving(ctx, x0, y0, x1, y1, tone) { var base = tone === 'warm' ? '#d9c9ab' : '#d5cfbf', jn = tone === 'warm' ? 'rgba(130,104,70,.32)' : 'rgba(118,110,92,.30)', w = x1 - x0, h = y1 - y0, st = 12;

    for (var x = x0 + st; x < x1 - 1; x += st) { ctx.moveTo(x, y0); ctx.lineTo(x, y1); } for (var y = y0 + st / 2; y < y1 - 1; y += st / 2) { var o = ((y - y0) / (st / 2)) % 2 ? st / 2 : 0; ctx.moveTo(x0, y); ctx.lineTo(x1, y); }

    // zonelook3: the ramps of the underground car parks — the slope going down (darker towards the bottom), the walls, the barrier and the sign
    (D.garages || []).forEach(function (g) { var r = g.ramp; if (!r || !inV(v, r[0] - 6, r[1] - 6, r[2] + 6, r[3] + 6)) return; var rw = r[2] - r[0], rh = r[3] - r[1], vert = g.gate === 'N' || g.gate === 'S';

(g.gate === 'N' ? r[3] + 6 : r[1] - 6) : r[1] - 6; ctx.fillRect(sx2 - 9, sy2 - 4, 18, 8); ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.font = '700 6px Arial'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.fillText('P', sx2, sy2 + 2.2); ctx.restore(); });

  // the city's pictures: one list, sorted north to south so the nearer item covers the farther one
  function list() { if (LIST) return LIST; LIST = [];
    (D.hedges || []).forEach(function (h) { LIST.push(h[2] === 'v' ? { a: 'TP-SH-02', x: h[0], y: h[1], tw: 15 } : { a: 'TP-SH-04', x: h[0], y: h[1], tw: 36 }); });   /* p472: גדר מצפון לדרום — שיחים צפופים (המבקר מ-11) */
    (D.flowers || []).forEach(function (f) { LIST.push({ a: f[0], x: f[1], y: f[2], tw: f[3] }); });
    (D.shrubs || []).forEach(function (f) { LIST.push({ a: f[0], x: f[1], y: f[2], tw: f[3] }); });
    (D.props || []).forEach(function (f) { LIST.push({ a: f[0], x: f[1], y: f[2], sc: f[3] }); });
    (D.lamps || []).forEach(function (f) { LIST.push({ a: f[0], x: f[1], y: f[2], tw: f[3], lamp: 1 }); });
    (D.trees || []).forEach(function (f) { LIST.push({ a: f[0], x: f[1], y: f[2], tw: f[3], tree: 1 }); });
    LIST.sort(function (p, q) { return (p.y + (p.tree ? 6 : 0)) - (q.y + (q.tree ? 6 : 0)) || p.x - q.x; }); return LIST; }
  // each item's size and draw options are asked once (TurboCity.info is not free), and the zone is skipped whole when it is out of view
  var BOX = null;
  function prep() { var L = list(); if (BOX) return L; BOX = [1e9, 1e9, -1e9, -1e9];
    L.forEach(function (o) { var O = o.sc ? { scale: o.sc } : { targetWidth: o.tw }, I = TurboCity.info(o.a, O); o.w = I.w; o.h = I.h; o.x0 = o.x - I.w / 2; o.y0 = o.y - I.h / 2; o.O = Object.assign({ mode: 'runtime', time: 0 }, O);
      BOX[0] = Math.min(BOX[0], o.x0); BOX[1] = Math.min(BOX[1], o.y0); BOX[2] = Math.max(BOX[2], o.x0 + o.w); BOX[3] = Math.max(BOX[3], o.y0 + o.h); }); return L; }
  // the special stalls (the plan, R25‑N‑12): the accessible one blue with the wheelchair sign, the electric one green with the plug — painted
  // over the stall (this pass runs after the stalls and before the parked cars)
  // zonelook3 (1.11, the owner 12:04 — one standard for the whole city, D‑333): the special stalls. Accessible: the stall painted blue, a white
  // border and the wheelchair; at its head a sign post with the blue plate. Electric: the stall outlined and tinted green, the plug on the
  // ground; at its head a charging station (the city's PR-12) with its cable and a sign post with the green plate. m.h = the stall's head (N/S/E/W).
  function head(m) { var s = m.r, h = m.h || 'N'; return h === 'N' ? [s[0] + (s[2] - s[0]) / 2, s[1], 0, -1] : h === 'S' ? [s[0] + (s[2] - s[0]) / 2, s[3], 0, 1] : h === 'E' ? [s[2], s[1] + (s[3] - s[1]) / 2, 1, 0] : [s[0], s[1] + (s[3] - s[1]) / 2, -1, 0]; }
  function wheel(ctx, cx, cy, k, col) { ctx.save(); ctx.translate(cx, cy); ctx.scale(k, k); ctx.fillStyle = col; ctx.strokeStyle = col; ctx.lineWidth = 1.1; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-.4, -4.6, 1.25, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-.9, -2.9); ctx.lineTo(-.9, .6); ctx.lineTo(2.4, .6); ctx.lineTo(3.4, 3.4); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-.9, -1.4); ctx.lineTo(1.6, -1.4); ctx.stroke(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-.6, 2.2, 2.6, Math.PI * .6, Math.PI * 2.2); ctx.stroke(); ctx.restore(); }
  function plug(ctx, cx, cy, k, col) { ctx.save(); ctx.translate(cx, cy); ctx.scale(k, k); ctx.fillStyle = col; ctx.fillRect(-2.4, -2.6, 4.8, 4.2); ctx.fillRect(-1.6, -4.6, 1, 2); ctx.fillRect(.6, -4.6, 1, 2); ctx.fillRect(-.5, 1.6, 1, 3.2);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(.4, -2.1); ctx.lineTo(-1, .1); ctx.lineTo(.1, .1); ctx.lineTo(-.6, 1.4); ctx.lineTo(1.2, -.8); ctx.lineTo(.1, -.8); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fillStyle = col === '#ffffff' ? '#3aa35b' : '#ffffff'; ctx.fill(); ctx.restore(); }
  function marks(ctx, v) { (D.marks || []).forEach(function (m) { var s = m.r; if (!inV(v, s[0], s[1], s[2], s[3])) return; var w = s[2] - s[0], h = s[3] - s[1], cx = s[0] + w / 2, cy = s[1] + h / 2, acc = m.k === 'acc', k = Math.min(w, h) / 14;
      if (acc) { ctx.fillStyle = '#2f63a8'; ctx.fillRect(s[0] + 1.5, s[1] + 1.5, w - 3, h - 3); ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.2; ctx.strokeRect(s[0] + 1.5, s[1] + 1.5, w - 3, h - 3); wheel(ctx, cx, cy, k, '#ffffff'); }
      else { ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(58,163,91,.38)'; ctx.fillRect(s[0] + 1.5, s[1] + 1.5, w - 3, h - 3); ctx.strokeStyle = '#3aa35b'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.6; ctx.strokeRect(s[0] + 1.5, s[1] + 1.5, w - 3, h - 3); ctx.fillStyle = '#3aa35b'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, 6.5 * k / 1.4, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill(); plug(ctx, cx, cy, k * .8, '#ffffff'); } }); }
  function posts(ctx, v) { (D.marks || []).forEach(function (m) { var s = m.r; if (!inV(v, s[0] - 20, s[1] - 30, s[2] + 20, s[3] + 20)) return; var H = head(m), acc = m.k === 'acc', px = H[0] + H[2] * 3 + (H[2] ? 0 : (s[2] - s[0]) / 2 - 3), py = H[1] + H[3] * 3 + (H[3] ? 0 : -(s[3] - s[1]) / 2 + 3);
      if (!acc && typeof TurboCity !== 'undefined') { var I = TurboCity.info('PR-12', { scale: .42 }), qx = H[0] + H[2] * 5, qy = H[1] + H[3] * 5; TurboCity.draw(ctx, 'PR-12', qx - I.w / 2, qy - I.h / 2, { mode: 'runtime', scale: .42, time: 0 });
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#1d2329'; ctx.lineWidth = .8; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(qx, qy); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(qx - H[3] * 4 + H[2] * -6, qy + H[3] * -6, H[0] - H[2] * 10, H[1] - H[3] * 10); ctx.stroke(); }
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(14,20,28,.25)'; ctx.fillRect(px, py, 4, 1.4); ctx.fillStyle = '#5b636a'; ctx.fillRect(px - .5, py - 13, 1.2, 13);   // the post (2.2 m)
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff'; ctx.fillRect(px - 3.6, py - 19.6, 7.2, 7.2); ctx.fillStyle = acc ? '#2f63a8' : '#2f63a8'; ctx.fillRect(px - 3.1, py - 19.1, 6.2, 6.2);   // the plate: P on blue
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff'; ctx.font = '700 5.2px Arial'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.fillText('P', px, py - 14.2);
      ctx.fillStyle = acc ? '#2f63a8' : '#3aa35b'; ctx.fillRect(px - 3.6, py - 12.4, 7.2, 4.6); if (acc) wheel(ctx, px + .2, py - 10.1, .42, '#ffffff'); else plug(ctx, px, py - 10.1, .45, '#ffffff'); }); }
  // zonelook3: the two hoops of the court, standing in 3/4 (K = 0.6): a pole outside the baseline, the arm, the board 1.8 m wide from 2.9 to 3.95 m, the rim at 3.05 m
  function hoops(ctx, v) { var C = D.court; if (!C || !inV(v, C[0] - 30, C[1] - 40, C[2] + 30, C[3] + 10)) return; var cy = (C[1] + C[3]) / 2, K6 = 6;
    [[C[0], 1], [C[2], -1]].forEach(function (e) { var px = e[0] - e[1] * 10, bx = e[0] + e[1] * 12, rx = e[0] + e[1] * 15.75;
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(14,20,28,.22)'; ctx.fillRect(px - 1, cy, 3 + 13, 2.5);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#3d464c'; ctx.fillRect(px - 1, cy - 3.4 * K6, 2.2, 3.4 * K6); ctx.fillRect(Math.min(px, bx), cy - 3.4 * K6, Math.abs(bx - px), 1.6);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f4f4f0'; ctx.fillRect(bx - 1.2, cy - 9 - 3.95 * K6, 2.4, (3.95 - 2.9) * K6 + 18 * .0); ctx.fillRect(bx - .8, cy - 9 - 3.95 * K6, 1.6, 18);
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#e2622b'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.1; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(rx, cy - 3.05 * K6, 2.6, 1.6, 0, 0, 6.2832); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.7)'; ctx.lineWidth = .5; for (var n = -2; n <= 2; n += 2) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(rx + n, cy - 3.05 * K6 + 1); ctx.lineTo(rx + n * .5, cy - 3.05 * K6 + 5); ctx.stroke(); } }); }
  function items(ctx, now, v, noMarks) { if (!D || typeof TurboCity === 'undefined') return; if (!noMarks) marks(ctx, v); var L = prep(), t = (now || 0) / 1000; if (!inV(v, BOX[0], BOX[1], BOX[2], BOX[3])) return; ctx.save(); hoops(ctx, v); posts(ctx, v);
    for (var i = 0; i < L.length; i++) { var o = L[i]; if (!inV(v, o.x0, o.y0, o.x0 + o.w, o.y0 + o.h)) continue; o.O.time = t; TurboCity.draw(ctx, o.a, o.x0, o.y0, o.O); }
    ctx.restore(); }
  // what moves: the fountain (rings and three jets), the sprinklers (a turning jet of drops), the flag

// The static world (ground, yards, buildings, roads, markings, crosswalks, street lights, bus-stop shelters, road names, rails) is
// rendered once into screen-resolution tiles (512×512 device pixels, keyed by zoom) and the frame draws ~6–12 tile images instead
// of ~10,000 canvas operations. Two cached layers keep the original stacking:
//   L0 — world shadow, grass, open sea          (opaque base)
//   live under — the animated water: the B2 lake + fish, the port sea, the east sea, the B6 beach (waves, foam)
//   L1 — everything static drawn above it        (transparent where the water is)
//   live over — animated sprites found inside the static functions (trees, plants, signs …), interaction markers, the waiting
//               counts at bus stops, the D4 gate arms, the D5 forklift task, the C6 yard tiers, the clarifier bridge, approach lights
// then the dynamic world (navigation, signals, passengers, trains, vehicles, people …) exactly as before.
// WTC_MODE tells the shared draw functions which pieces to draw: 0 classic (all, original order) · 1 static (tiles) · 2 live over ·
// 3 live under. Animated sprites are detected per asset/options by rendering them at several times; in static mode they are skipped
// and re-drawn live from a list recorded once per zoom (with their exact transform and time offset). Static Targets (debug picking)
// are captured by the same pass, so they still exist while their tiles are cached.

 const Nm=P.map((p,i)=>{const a=P[Math.max(0,i-1)],b=P[Math.min(N,i+1)],dx=b[0]-a[0],dy=b[1]-a[1],l=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;return[-dy/l,dx/l]});
 const ins=new Map(),inset=d=>{let q=ins.get(d);if(!q){q=P.map((p,i)=>[p[0]-d*Nm[i][0],Math.max(0,p[1]-d*Nm[i][1])]);ins.set(d,q)}return q};
 // the whole outline as a path (d > 0 — inside, d < 0 — outside)
 const loopB=(t,d)=>{const q=d?inset(d):P;t.moveTo(q[0][0],q[0][1]);for(let i=1;i<=N;i++)t.lineTo(q[i][0],q[i][1]);for(let i=N;i>=0;i--)t.lineTo(q[i][0],-q[i][1]);t.closePath()},loop=(c,d)=>{c.beginPath();loopB(c,d)};
 // the paths that are the same in every picture of the model — kept once (Path2D) for the real canvases
 const pc=new Map(),path2=(k,b)=>{let p=pc.get(k);if(!p){p=new Path2D();b(p);pc.set(k,p)}return p};
 // the indices of a stretch of the outline: from x ≥ a, and (near the ends) while |y| ≥ yb
 const fromX=a=>{let i=0;while(i<N&&P[i][0]<a)i++;return i},lastY=(i0,yb)=>{let j=i0;while(j<N&&P[j+1][1]>=yb)j++;return j},firstY=(i1,yb)=>{let j=i1;while(j>0&&P[j-1][1]>=yb)j--;return j};

 const band=(c,s,i0,i1,d0,d1)=>{const a=inset(d0),b=inset(d1);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(a[i0][0],s*a[i0][1]);for(let i=i0+1;i<=i1;i++)c.lineTo(a[i][0],s*a[i][1]);for(let i=i1;i>=i0;i--)c.lineTo(b[i][0],s*b[i][1]);c.closePath()};
 const line=(c,s,i0,i1,d)=>{const a=inset(d);c.moveTo(a[i0][0],s*a[i0][1]);for(let i=i0+1;i<=i1;i++)c.lineTo(a[i][0],s*a[i][1])};
 // the front band across the nose (both sides through the middle), for |y| ≤ yb
 const nose=(c,yb,d0,d1)=>{const j=lastY(fromX(L/2-zf),yb)+1,a=inset(d0),b=inset(d1);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(a[j][0],a[j][1]);for(let i=j+1;i<=N;i++)c.lineTo(a[i][0],a[i][1]);for(let i=N;i>=j;i--)c.lineTo(a[i][0],-a[i][1]);
  for(let i=j;i<=N;i++)c.lineTo(b[i][0],-b[i][1]);for(let i=N;i>=j;i--)c.lineTo(b[i][0],b[i][1]);c.closePath()};
 const tail=(c,yb,d0,d1)=>{const j=firstY(fromX(X+zr),yb)-1,a=inset(d0),b=inset(d1);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(a[j][0],a[j][1]);for(let i=j-1;i>=0;i--)c.lineTo(a[i][0],a[i][1]);for(let i=0;i<=j;i++)c.lineTo(a[i][0],-a[i][1]);
  for(let i=j;i>=0;i--)c.lineTo(b[i][0],-b[i][1]);for(let i=0;i<=j;i++)c.lineTo(b[i][0],b[i][1]);c.closePath()};
 G={D,P,N,hw,inset,loop,loopB,path2,band,line,nose,tail,fromX,lastY,firstY,tyL,arch,zf,zr};VDG.set(id,G);return G}
// a lamp along the outline at a corner (s = side): f — the front, else the rear; the stretch from x (inside) to |y| = yb at the end

 else{G.band(c,s,j0,i1,d0-.25,d1+.3);c.fillStyle=housing;c.fill();G.band(c,s,j0,i1,d0,d1);c.fillStyle=lens;c.fill();if(glow){c.strokeStyle=glow;c.lineWidth=.45;c.beginPath();G.line(c,s,j0,i1,d0+.3);c.stroke()}}}

// ---- C34 ----
/* ===== C34 · the 3/4 vehicles (exp34 → main line p378, S7F133) =====
   The projection (shared with the buildings): world x east, y south, z up (game px, 10 px = 1 m); screen = (x, y − z·K), K = 0.6.
   The ground plan is not foreshortened, so the footprint of a car is exactly today's footprint; a horizontal surface at height z is
   today's top-down picture moved up by z·K.  The car is therefore built as a height field over today's top-down picture (the painter
   veh() above, copied from the game): every surface that is seen from above (the hood, the boot, the shoulders, the fascia band, the
   windshield, the roof) is drawn by mapping today's picture onto it, one affine piece per triangle; the faces that the top-down view never
   showed (the lower sides, the side glass, the lower front / rear, the wheels, the mirrors, the spoiler, the inside of the bed) are drawn
   in code.  One picture per model × paint × direction × density, cached. */
const K34 = 0.6;
const C34 = G.C34 = { K: K34, dirs: 16, SUN: { x: 0.25, y: 0.32 } };

TurboCity.get(m[0]) : null } catch (e) { a = null } if (a && a.fp && a.fp[3] > 0) m[4] = a.fp[3]; else if (W6ALL[m[0]]) m[4] = W6ALL[m[0]]; m.w0 = w0 }   // p440: the painter's width (the class's real width)
for (const m of VM.slice()) if (/^V[HS]-[A-Z]{2}-\d\d$/.test(m[0])) { const f = Object.assign(m.slice(), m); f[0] = m[0] + '~F'; f[4] = m.w0; f.frozen = 1; VM.push(f) }   // p440: the frozen twin of each road model (the field, p440c) — today's width
